title: Pocketsflow: creator payments with a halftone mascot
summary: A 42 s vertical explainer for a creator-payments platform, voiced by a friendly narrator. A black-and-white halftone 3D mascot boy waves, points and reacts from the bottom of the frame while a phone mockup above walks through each step: product tiles, creator page build, templates, add products, share link, checkout, memberships, global tax, payouts, ending with 'Handled.' stamp and 'You create. We handle the rest.' Each chapter has its own pastel background and a sans + serif-italic headline.
fit_reason: Step-by-step 'pick, add, share, get paid' walkthrough on a phone with VO and per-chapter headline is an ideal onboarding explainer format; swap the mascot for a halftone cut-out of Andrew to keep it human.

palette.mood: clean white with saturated cobalt hook, then a pastel per-chapter rotation (blue, lilac, pink, mint, sage); halftone grain on the mascot

typography.display: neutral grotesk (Inter/Söhne medium) + serif italic accent word (Instrument Serif / Editorial New italic) in a chapter colour
typography.size_behaviour: medium top-left headline (~5% height) above the phone; tiny mono eyebrow ('// hosted checkout', '// global tax')
typography.notes: Pattern: 'Pick a look.', 'Add your products.', 'Share one link.', 'Checkout in seconds.', 'merchant of record.' where the last word is a coloured serif italic. Monospace for code-ish eyebrows and URLs.

text_animation: headline words appear one by one in sync with the VO
accent word writes on in italic with slight y-rise and blur
'Handled.' blue stamp/sticker slams in rotated over a grid of all screens
captions: phrase-level headline doubles as caption: synced to VO, top-left, no box, last word coloured serif italic
motion: halftone 3D mascot animated (wave, point, thumbs, scratch head) anchored bottom-left
phone mockup builds UI piece by piece (avatar, name, buttons) as narrator speaks
template thumbnails explode out in a fan behind the phone
product tiles pop into a 2x2 grid with spring
card-style chapters slide like a carousel with depth blur
zoom-out to a collage of all chapter screens
transitions: horizontal card slide with motion blur
graphic_elements: colourful product tiles with halftone images
checkout form, payouts card, tax receipt
small circular mascot avatar in corner of each card
ui_treatment: rebuilt UI inside a clean flat phone mockup, each chapter on a large rounded pastel card

sound.voiceover: yes - friendly upbeat narrator ('Psst! Got something to sell? Courses, ebooks, presets, apps! With Pocketsflow you get your own creator page in minutes. Pick a look. Add your products. Share one link.')
sound.sync: headlines and UI builds locked to VO phrases

signature_moves: black-and-white halftone 3D mascot reacting at frame bottom
sans headline with one coloured serif-italic word per chapter
rubber-stamp 'Handled.' over a collage of every step

best_segments.what: 'Got something' then cobalt background, product tiles pop into a grid while mascot waves
'creator page in minutes.' builds on the phone in sync with VO, italic accent word
'Add your products.' / 'Share one link.' with copied-link chip and social icons
'Handled.' stamp over collage, then black 'You create. We handle the rest.'

recreate.how: Remotion with VO timestamps. Phone mockup + UI as React; chapter cards on a horizontal track. The mascot needs a 3D character render or a halftone-filtered cut-out of a real person (ffmpeg/ImageMagick halftone or a shader) - for SaaSSuite use Andrew's real footage halftoned, which respects the AI rules.
recreate.prompt: Vertical 9:16; halftone black-and-white character at the bottom reacting; a phone mockup above builds a product page step by step in sync with a friendly VO; headline top-left in grotesk with the last word in coloured serif italic; each chapter on its own pastel card (blue #d2dffb, mint #cfecea); finish with a 'Handled.' stamp.
